speaker: character
text: Everyone's just standing around. There are twice as many of us as they planned. Do you know what's going on?

speaker: candidate
text: Okay everyone, listen to me! Follow me, I'll run this.

speaker: character
text: Some people are already leaving. We've got eighty people and forty pairs of gloves. What do we do?

speaker: candidate
text: We make teams of four with two pairs of gloves each and rotate.

speaker: character
text: Should we split the park into zones? Someone has to lead each one.

speaker: candidate
text: I'll lead all the zones myself. Everyone just report to me.

speaker: character
text: Someone found a pile of broken glass and rusty metal by the playground. Half of them don't have gloves. What do we do?

speaker: candidate
text: Safety first. Nobody touches the glass; let's mark it off.

speaker: character
text: Here's Asel, the organiser. She looks surprised. She's asking who's been running things.

speaker: candidate
text: I had to take charge, nobody else would. Honestly, it's better if I keep running it.

speaker: character
text: It's starting to rain. Half the bags are full and people want to go. What now?

speaker: candidate
text: Nobody leaves until the park is clean. A bit of rain never hurt anyone.
